claim.claim-text: 1. A handle apparatus for an anchor delivery system, comprising:
2. The handle of claim 1, wherein rotation of the cam wheel accomplishes releasing the energy loaded into the first spring by allowing the first sled to return rapidly to the first sled position.
3. The handle of claim 1 or claim 2, further comprising a second spring connected to a second sled, wherein rotation of the cam wheel loads energy into the second spring.
4. The handle of claim 3, wherein the second sled is configured to be placed in a locked position when energy has been loaded into the second spring.
5. The handle of claim 4, wherein rotation of the cam wheel releases the second sled from the locked position causing the second sled to return rapidly to a second sled position.
6. The handle of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the lever includes lever teeth that mesh with the plurality of drive gear teeth.
7. The handle of any one of claims 1 to 6, further comprising a safety having a position that prevents operation of the handle.
8. The handle of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the handle is configured to couple with a cartridge of the anchor delivery system.
9. The handle of claim 8 wherein the first sled includes a complementary mechanism for transferring energy from the first sled to the cartridge.
10. The handle of claim 9, wherein transferring energy from the first sled to the cartridge causes a needle to be deployed from the cartridge.
